title: Rust generic SCHC rules ignore descriptor matches and normalize packet fields
description: Correctness review: Rust Rules0/1/5/6 do not enforce zero TC/Flow Label or CoAP Version=1 before eliding them, then reconstruct canonical values and corrupt valid non-matches; Python selection diverges. Enforce every Equal/MSB field in RULE_SET_V3, fallback valid non-matches to Rule255 unchanged, and add shared TC/Flow/CoAP-version/TKL/token vectors.
